notes: Closed-loop demo: planted causes are a partly blocked nozzle (continuous band hidden under mill tension, visible after tension release, nozzle_thermal_stripe) and a cooling-zone valve closure (cooling_zone_switching_transient).

Route: plant statements (50 um input, two single-sheet passes, final usually 17-19 um, down to 12 um); the intermediates 30 um and 25 um, the S1-S3 stock route, the alloy (1235-like) and the temper (H18) are ASSUMED: the plant has not stated the alloy and temper. The demo assumes a standard-grade H18 collector foil (finished tensile strength 165-190 MPa in the battery report); all mill and material numbers are synthetic.
At 30 um the mill is in or near closed-gap rolling, which the tool does not model: see the foil-regime block. The lever table and the gauge-control section assume an open gap.

Phase-1 coolant section kept consistent with width_model.spray_header; its geometric screen can only represent a FULLY blocked nozzle, so nozzle 11 is listed as blocked there although width_model gives it flow level 0.45.

worse_at_lower_tension is left null although the model in-mill onset of the stripe falls with tension (6.8 um at 40 MPa, 1.6 um at 8 MPa at the case pass): a band hidden under tension is also "worse at lower tension", so this observation does not separate foil tension lines from a latent thermal stripe.

Final pass F2 0.030 -> 0.018 mm (plant final gauge 17-19 um) and the thinnest product's alternative route ALT1 0.050 -> 0.025 mm and ALT2 0.025 -> 0.012 mm (52 %): the passes below 20 um get experimental mattress bites in the extended domain, flagged; the 12 um bite is expected to lie outside the force range reported for battery-foil passes and is then marked not credible and excluded from every trend statement. Speeds follow published practice: 450-650 m/min on the single-sheet final pass, 550-1000 m/min on earlier passes. The plant rolls the final pass single-sheet (plant statement; material.final_pass_doubled false). material.product battery_collector_foil drives the evidence-neutral product check.
inputs.provenance: SYNTHETIC demonstration, not plant data, for EV battery cathode current-collector foil (1235-H18-like). ROUTE FROM THE PLANT (plant statements): the foil mill takes a 50 um input and reaches final gauge in TWO single-sheet passes; the final gauge is usually 17-19 um and can go down to 12 um. The intermediate gauge, the alloy and the temper were NOT stated: 30 um (50 -> 30 -> 18 um, 40 % per pass; published 34 -> 20 and 32 -> 17 um passes are its neighbours) is ASSUMED for the usual product and 25 um (50 -> 25 -> 12 um, 50 % then 52 %, matching the published 50 -> 25 -> 15 and 55 -> 25 -> 12 um passes) for the thinnest [battery report, catalogue product battery_collector_foil]. Every mill and material number below remains synthetic. Foil mill: single-stand four-high, work roll 0.27 m diameter (230-330 mm reported, 260-280 typical [V S8]), backup roll 0.75 m (2.8 x the work roll; 2.4-2.8 x reported [V S8]), barrel 1.5 m, strip 1.2 m centred. Half-stack masses and stiffnesses are planner ESTIMATES scaled from the sheet demo mill [D]: work roll 1100 kg (steel barrel pi*0.135^2*1.5*7850 = 674 kg plus necks and chocks), backup roll 9000 kg (barrel 5200 kg plus necks and chocks), work/backup contact 2.0e10 N/m (shorter, smaller-diameter contact than the sheet mill 4e10), housing 6.0e9 N/m (lighter foil stand; sheet mill 1.4e10); 3 m free spans. thermal_events.attribution_definition: event metrics use the monitor history from the event start to attribution_window_end_s: the start of the next event switching nozzles within the isolation margin (0.1 m) of this one, else the end of the run; a fade beyond it gives only a lower bound (flag FADE_BEYOND_ATTRIBUTION_WINDOW), a later event starting during this one truncates its peak (flag PEAK_TRUNCATED_BY_LATER_EVENT); an earlier event in the same neighbourhood leaves its residual in the history (flag EARLIER_EVENT_IN_SAME_REGION)
thermal_events.band_life_definition: band_life_s = event duration + time after the event ends for the stripe to fall below the manifest threshold (or the reporting threshold when it never becomes manifest)
thermal_events.growth_rate_note: Radius growth follows the radial heat integral, so right after a spray change the stripe grows at 2*alpha*factor*dq/(rho*c) whatever the radial distribution; short-lived bands arise because the stripe crosses the manifest threshold within seconds to tens of seconds and fades over about a minute after the zone returns, not because the roll skin responds fast.
thermal_events.open_discrepancy: The 20 s first-order flatness response identified on a plant (Dohmae & Okamura 2012) is faster than this model's decay; possible causes (none modelled): bite heat depending on the roll surface temperature, emulsion-level heat transfer, per-revolution effects.
thermal_events.stripe_definition: one monitor per connected group of adjacent switched nozzles (a stripe); the stripe with the largest peak radius deviation governs the event metrics (governing_stripe_index), the others are listed under stripes
thermal_events.visible_time_definition: visible_time_s = time above the in-mill manifest threshold if reached, else above the after-release threshold, else above the reporting threshold (visible_time_basis says which); thresholds are stripe heights at the monitor position, from the peak profile scaled (onsets on a >= 10 mm grid)

thermal_steady.stripe_method: difference actual header - healthy header (same pass), thresholded directly (no polynomial de-trend)
